entities.name: Kalyntri
entities.description: A red-scaled dragon who has ruled part of the Kapsho seas for over three hundred years and is killed by Talrand's drakes.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A powerful merfolk mage with drake servants who claims the Kapsho seas as his kingdom and defeats Kalyntri.

entities.name: Drakes
entities.description: Numerous scavenging drakes that serve Talrand and swarm Kalyntri from a storm cloud.

entities.name: Baloths
entities.description: Ferocious predators that live on an island and yield to Kalyntri.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Sea people whom Kalyntri has hunted and eaten, and to whom Talrand belongs.

entities.name: Kapsho seas
entities.description: The ocean and archipelagos that were Kalyntri's dominion and that Talrand proclaims his kingdom.

events.summary: Kalyntri kills and eats a baloth, then roars triumph so that Talrand will hear.
events.quote: Kalyntri paused from eating to roar his triumph to the sky and sea.

events.summary: Kalyntri recalls how Talrand had appeared in one of his lairs a year ago and escaped a blast of flame, and that Talrand now has drake servants.
events.quote: Talrand was merely gone, and only the problem of him, and his drakes, remained.

events.summary: Kalyntri spots Talrand standing on the open water beneath a lone dark storm cloud and swoops to kill him.
events.quote: He swooped low, eagerly, not wanting to lose Talrand again like he did the first time they met.

events.summary: Talrand says he did not want to kill Kalyntri but found no path to keep him alive.
events.quote: I didn't want to have to kill you.

events.summary: Kalyntri attacks with flame while Talrand uses fog, geysers and water walls to evade him.
events.quote: Kalyntri roared, an incandescent rush of rage that transmuted into scalding flame

events.summary: Kalyntri bludgeons Talrand with his tail and body, sending him skipping onto an island beach.
events.quote: The impact of the blow sent Talrand sprawling across the water once more before skipping onto the beach of one of the nearby islands.

events.summary: Talrand announces he brings the dragon rain, and dozens of drakes fall on Kalyntri from the storm cloud.
Kalyntri realizes he is losing as the drakes bite him and a geyser slams him onto the beach.
events.quote: It suddenly occurred to Kalyntri that he was losing.

events.summary: Talrand gives Kalyntri to a large drake as promised, and the drake bites through the dragon's neck, killing him.
events.quote: Service to me means an end to the tyranny of dragons. He is yours.

relations.note: They serve him in exchange for an end to the tyranny of dragons.
relations.quote: such as those who now served the upstart Talrand.

relations.note: Kalyntri hunts Talrand, who proclaimed himself ruler of the Kapsho.
relations.quote: Talrand's reign would come to a bloody end once his head was ripped from his shoulders

relations.note: A drake bites through the dragon's neck.
relations.quote: the dragon felt sharp jaws at his unprotected neck, and he felt them crunch.
The drake looked back at Talrand, and Talrand nodded.
